import os
import re
import sys


def main():
    with open("./data/nested.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()

    # Every non-negative decimal integer in the file, at any nesting depth.
    total = sum(int(tok) for tok in re.findall(r"\d+", text))

    os.makedirs("./out", exist_ok=True)
    with open("./out/answer.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(str(total) + "\n")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
